description: Presidential Secretariat - Enlarged  the time Period of Investigating Corruption fraud etc. Published in Gaz.Ex.No. 2106/11
categorisation: This gazette content involves the President exercising powers under the Commission Inquiry Act to extend the deadline for a commission's final report. It deals with legal procedures, statutory instruments, and the operation of an established legal framework (commission of inquiry), which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions the President by name, it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would qualify for Types 1-3. The content is specifically about legal procedures and regulatory extensions rather than government administration or personnel matters.
